title: Wade in the Water
description: The spiritual, for 2 to 4 singers: the chorus, two verses and the chorus between and after. In the verses the soprano calls and the others answer "God's a-going to trouble the water", while the bass keeps the groove underneath on "doom, ba-doom".

licence.words: public domain: traditional, published 1901 in New Jubilee Songs as Sung by the Fisk Jubilee Singers (Frederick J. Work and John Wesley Work II; died 1942 and 1925)
licence.tune: public domain: traditional, published 1901 (as above), printed in E minor
licence.source: melody and words read from New Jubilee Songs, 2nd ed. (1904), pages 8 and 9, scanned by the Auburn Avenue Research Library (Digital Library of Georgia), transposed from E minor to G minor; history in Wikipedia, "Wade in the Water"; not any later arrangement
